name: paladin-sdk-smoke
description: TypeScript generated-client smoke test for the sdk-clients CI job (D-49, PLAT-FR-17). Not published. The generated `paladin-sdk` package is a build artefact, not a resolvable dependency: `run.sh` installs it separately, after `npm ci`, from its local build directory (`target/sdk/typescript`) via `npm install --no-save` -- a `file:` dependency on a tree that does not exist until CI generates it cannot be resolved by a committed package-lock.json.
